# DontreeCrab NCN sample (test-only fixture)

Original source: https://github.com/PCXzaKittiphoom/DontreeCrab (testdata/ncn)
Generated by upstream `scripts/make_testdata.py`, then downloaded unchanged.
License: MIT — see LICENSE in this directory.

This is an upstream **synthetic**, English-language test triplet, NOT
evidence that every third-party Nick Karaoke/eXtreme Karaoke track works.
It is deliberately small and includes 13 unconsumed trailing CUR entries.
Keep Song/1/test.mid, Lyrics/1/test.lyr and Cursor/1/test.cur together.
